goals: Verify that addListStyle correctly applies bulleted and numbered list styles (including auto-incrementing numbers) to the text and updates the cursor position accordingly.
Verify that addListStyle leaves the element unmodified when no list style is provided.
activities: Create an element object with test text and selection boundaries at 0
Execute addListStyle with the element and a null style
Verify the element's value and selection boundaries remain unchanged
Create an element object with text ending in a newline and cursor at the end
Execute addListStyle with the element and the bulleted list style
Verify the resulting value has a bullet point appended and the cursor is positioned at the end
Create an element object with multiline text and cursor in the middle
Execute addListStyle with the element and the bulleted list style
Verify the resulting value has a bullet point inserted at the cursor and the cursor position is updated
Create an element object with text ending in a newline and cursor at the end
Execute addListStyle with the element and the numbered list style
Verify the resulting value has '1. ' appended and the cursor is positioned at the end
Create an element object containing an existing numbered list item and cursor at the end
Execute addListStyle with the element and the numbered list style
Verify the resulting value succeeds the previous number with '2. ' and the cursor is positioned at the end
Create an element object with multiline text and cursor in the middle
Execute addListStyle with the element and the numbered list style
Verify the resulting value has '1. ' inserted at the cursor and the cursor position is updated
Create an element object containing an existing numbered list item and cursor in the middle
Execute addListStyle with the element and the numbered list style
Verify the resulting value succeeds the previous number with '24. ' inserted at the cursor and the cursor position is updated
